takes_effect: when merged into main; must precede 2026-12-09, the first target date of an issued forecast

issuance.cadence: weekly, one record covering all six reservoirs
issuance.origin: the Monday immediately before the issue day
issuance.missed_week: ledger line with reason; counts against availability
issuance.scheduler: none until this protocol is merged and the persistent store is verified

scoring.observation: CDEC daily reservoir storage, sensor 15, retrieved at scoring time
scoring.realised_change: 100 * (S[target] - S[origin]) / capacity in force at origin (from the record)

baseline.name: smoothed day-of-year seasonal (fixed)
baseline.kernel: Gaussian on circular origin day-of-year distance, sigma 15 days, per reservoir

primary.P1: A vs doy_seasonal, paired MAE difference
primary.decision: supported only if the 95% CI upper bound is below zero at all three block lengths; otherwise not established
